verdict.rationale: Aircall's own AI Agents handle calls and repetitive requests automatically. AI Assistants update CRM records and create follow-up tasks without user action, and IVR routing runs on business-hours schedules. That is real built-in background automation, but the evidence is marketing one-liners with no documented way for a user to set up or configure their own autonomous automations. The API/webhook tutorials are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented user-facing automation or workflow builder, detail on triggers, scheduling and configuration of autonomous agent tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: AI Agents handle after-hours calls, manage peak volume, and respond to repetitive requests automatically.
AI Assistants capture notes, update CRM records, and create follow-up tasks automatically
Route incoming calls automatically using a keypad menu (IVR) so callers can reach the right team, combined with business-hours scheduling
pulling order details from Shopify, processing a refund in Stripe, booking a meeting in your calendar, and logging the outcome in your CRM
